item.name: create sequence enrollment step query job

request.name: create sequence enrollment step query job

description.content:
Start an asynchronous query job that exports sequence enrollment steps —
per-person executions of each sequence step, including sent email
engagement and any reply. Omitting `filter` exports all enrollment
steps. Poll the job until it is `FINISHED`, then page through the
results.
